result.title: CLOSE: A Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating Verifier for Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
result.comment: 41 pages (8-page main text and appendix), 25 figures, 24 tables
result.summary: Vision-language models frequently describe objects absent from the image because of language priors. Yet the model itself is already a strong judge of its own output: asked separately whether an object is present, it rejects 44%-62% of its hallucinations, and its yes probability reaches an AUROC of 0.90-0.95 without training. This judgment, however, is not directly usable: (1) its probabilities lack a common scale across models; (2) for the remaining 38%-56%, the model still answers yes with probabilities that overlap those of real objects, so no threshold separates them. We therefore propose CLOSE, a Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating verifier that enforces this judgment during generation. Its threshold is a quantile of a memory rather than a probability and thus depends only on ranks; the memory is cold-started from unlabeled images and updated online. A scorer self-trained on pseudo-labels from four hidden-state signals is fused with self-asking by rank to separate what self-asking leaves mixed. Refused objects are rolled back and banned through a laddered back-off, and a recognition table intercepts their reappearance under other wordings. On COCO, refusing 20% and 40% of object mentions reduces the CHAIRs of LLaVA-1.5-7B by 42% and 87% (F1 +1.9 and -6.1 points); refusing 20% and 35% reduces the reachable hallucinations of Qwen3-VL-8B (official counts minus CHAIR-script miscounts) by 79% and 96% (F1 +0.5 and -5.3). An external vocabulary further extends the check beyond the official vocabulary.

AI.brief_summary: CLOSE 提出免训练的在线自评估验证器以抑制 VLM 物体幻觉：以记忆分位数（仅依赖排名）设阈、由无标注图像冷启动并在线更新，融合自提问与基于四个隐藏状态信号伪标签训练的打分器，被拒对象回滚并通过阶梯回退与识别表拦截其复现。
AI.relevance_reason: 四个隐藏状态信号用于判定物体是否存在，可直接对照内部状态是否保留视觉证据、以及拒绝与回滚这类停止决策的收益成本；其免标签在线校准究竟是依据视觉证据还是表面统计，可供核查。
